name: Kt Medical Service Public Company Limited
summary: Kt Medical Service Public Company Limited, established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, primarily runs hemodialysis facilities throughout Thailand. Beyond its core operations, the company also supplies specialized water purification systems for hemodialysis procedures and offers a range of medical products and support services. As of July 22, 2022, it managed 19 hemodialysis units across the country.
